description: This file defines the context creation logic for a tRPC server in a Next.js application, including types, context initialization functions, and external dependencies related to request context, localization, tracing, and database access.

methods.name: createContextInner
methods.description: Creates an inner context for tRPC procedures, including tracing and database references.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates the full context for incoming requests, including localization, IP, session, and inner context.
